parameters.disposition_precedence: ambiguous over incomplete over bound; no construction is not-a-claim
parameters.pr_cues: release PR|released as PR|PR ... released ... tag
parameters.record_boundary: a direct release-PR cue starts a record and the next direct release-PR cue ends it
parameters.squash_cues: squash between the record release PR and tag
parameters.sync_cues: marketplace sync|marketplace sync commit|unqualified sync|unqualified sync commit after tag

policies.ranking: construction boundaries assign a record; within it no candidates are ranked and only cardinality-one role sets are filled

parameters.date_equivalence: YYYYMMDD in run id equals YYYY-MM-DD with optional trailing Z
parameters.disposition_precedence: ambiguous over bound over incomplete over not-a-claim
parameters.full_timestamp_fallback: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]Z connected by a direct form yields incomplete
parameters.whitespace_normalization: collapse ASCII whitespace for connector matching only

policies.ranking: none; construction-qualified physical candidates are deduplicated but never proximity-ranked
